title: Counting and Covering in Nearest-Neighbour Representations of Boolean Functions
abstract: arXiv:2609.23094v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the number of prototypes needed to represent Boolean functions by nearest-neighbour classification. There are two distinct settings: the prototypes may be arbitrary points of Euclidean space, or they may themselves be required to lie in the Boolean cube. For unrestricted prototypes, we strengthen a known lower bound for almost all Boolean functions. The bound applies simultaneously to nearest-neighbour voting rules with any number of voting neighbours, and substantially narrows the gap with the known general upper bound. We obtain a VC-dimension bound for classes with a bounded number of prototypes, and show that it is sharp in order in dimensions at least four. We then study Boolean prototypes, beginning with symmetric threshold functions. A connection with covering designs expresses the minimum number of prototypes at every threshold level exactly in terms of a covering number, and leads to further exact results for related

translated_title: 布尔函数最近邻表示中的计数与覆盖
translated_abstract: 我们研究了用最近邻分类来表示布尔函数所需的原型数量。这里存在两种不同的设定：原型可以是欧几里得空间中的任意点，或者原型本身被要求必须位于布尔立方体中。对于无限制的原型，我们加强了针对几乎所有布尔函数的一个已知下界。该下界同时适用于具有任意数量投票邻居的最近邻投票规则，并大幅缩小了与已知一般上界之间的差距。我们为原型数量有界的函数类获得了VC维上界，并证明该界在维数至少为4时在数量级上是紧的。随后我们研究布尔原型情形，从对称阈值函数入手。通过与覆盖设计的联系，我们精确地用覆盖数刻画了每个阈值水平下的最小原型数量，并由此得到了相关函数类的进一步精确结果。
tldr: 本文研究了用最近邻分类表示布尔函数所需的原型数量：对任意原型情形加强了几乎所有布尔函数的下界并证明VC维界在维数≥4时是紧的，同时借助覆盖设计理论精确刻画了对称阈值函数在每个阈值水平下的最小原型数。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the number of prototypes needed for nearest-neighbour representations of Boolean functions, strengthening lower bounds for almost all Boolean functions with unrestricted prototypes, proving a sharp VC-dimension bound in dimensions at least four, and exactly characterizing the minimum prototype number for symmetric threshold functions via a connection with covering designs.
